title: 1986 AHSME Problem 19
statement: A park is in the shape of a regular hexagon \(2\) km on a side. Starting at a corner, Alice walks along the perimeter of the park for a distance of \(5\) km. How many kilometers is she from her starting point?

solutions.text:
Choose the first side in the horizontal direction. The three directed portions of the walk have vectors \[ \begin{gathered} (2,0),\qquad (1,\sqrt3),\\ \left(-\frac12,\frac{\sqrt3}{2}\right). \end{gathered} \] Their sum is \((\frac{5}{2},\frac{3\sqrt3}{2}).\) Its squared length is \[ \left(\frac52\right)^2+\left(\frac{3\sqrt3}{2}\right)^2=13. \] The distance is therefore \(\sqrt{13}\) km.

Thus the correct answer is A.
hints: The walk consists of two complete sides and half of the next side
Resolve the three directed segments into horizontal and vertical components
